samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed/unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend input.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor input.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A valid operation request signal.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A signal indicating that the result is valid.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The result, containing remainder and quotient.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="N" value="8">The number of bits for the dividend and divisor.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="signed_dividend" width_description="[N-1:0]">The signed representation of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_dividend" width_description="[N-1:0]">The absolute value of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[N-1:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt" width_description="[N-1:0]">Start counter for the division process.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt" width_description="[N-1:0]">Counter for the division process.</signal>
        <signal id="SR" width_description="[2*N-1:0]">Shift register for storing intermediate results.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[N-1:0]">Subtraction result.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out" width_description="[N-1:0]">Carry-out result.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_result" width_description="[N-1:0]">Multiplexed result.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for saving inputs and initializing variables
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                abs_dividend <= 0;
                neg_divisor <= 0;
                SR <= 0;
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(opn_valid && ~res_valid) begin
                    abs_dividend <= (sign & dividend[N-1]) ? (~dividend + 1) : dividend;
                    neg_divisor <= (sign & divisor[N-1]) ? (~divisor + 1) : divisor;
                    SR <= {abs_dividend << 1};
                    cnt <= 1;
                    start_cnt <= 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for performing division operations
        always @(*) begin
            if(start_cnt) begin
                if(cnt[3]) begin
                    cnt = 0;
                    start_cnt = 0;
                    SR = {sub_result, SR[7:1]};
                end else begin
                    cnt = cnt + 1;
                    SR = {mux_result, SR[7:1]};
                end
            end
        end
        // Subtraction operation
        assign sub_result = SR[2 * N - 1 -: N] - neg_divisor;
        
        // Mux selection based on carry_out
        assign mux_result = sub_result[N-1] ? SR[2 * N - 1 -: N] : sub_result;
        
        // Output assignment
        assign res_valid = (cnt == 0);
        assign result = {SR[2 * N - 1 -: N], SR[7:0]};
    </implementation>
</module>
